remarks: For Lease - 270 Main Ave, Norwalk, CT - 2nd Floor    Approximately 1,200 SF of modern office space available on the second floor of a recently renovated building. The suite features a flexible open layout, two private offices with floor-to-ceiling glass, a kitchen area, and convenient access to two bathrooms. High-end, energy-efficient triple pane windows on all exterior walls provide abundant natural sunlight throughout the space, creating a bright and welcoming work environment.    Located on Main Avenue, this property offers high visibility and excellent accessibility, with close proximity to the Merritt Parkway, Route 7, restaurants, retail, and major corporate campuses. Ideal for a variety of professional office uses.
